ceterms:description.en-US: This course covers principles, mechanisms, and policies governing confidentiality, integrity, and availability of digital information. Topics to be covered include security concepts and mechanisms, security policies, multilevel security models, system vulnerability, threat and risk assessment, basic cryptography and its applications, intrusion detection systems. Graduate degree credit will not be given for both CSCE 48503 and CSCE 58503. Prerequisite: CSCE 31903 or Computer Science Computer Engineering (CSCE) graduate standing. (Typically offered: Irregular)
